source.instrument_type_source: Series-only read-back. Instrument metadata was outside run authority and was not queried; unknown is retained. Reader version is local Go build metadata.

enrichment_labels.provenance: Grafana Cloud aggregated-series marker applied stack-side after ingest. Prometheus reserves double-underscore label names for internal use and drops them before ingestion, so no collector can emit this key at egress; only a read-path producer observes it.

Grafana Cloud Asserts pipeline label applied stack-side after ingest. signals/k8s.md records that real series carry it and that synthkit deliberately does not emit Asserts labels; only a read-path producer observes it.

Grafana Cloud Adaptive Metrics writes this marker into a retained label's value when it aggregates the series away, replacing the real value after ingest. The key itself is genuine kube-proxy collector-egress evidence and still compares; only this marker value is a read-path artefact, and only a read-path producer observes it.
